commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== step 1: create system user =="
sudo -n useradd --system --no-create-home --shell /sbin/nologin inventorysvc
id inventorysvc

echo "== step 2: write systemd unit =="
sudo -n tee /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service > /dev/null <<'UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory Worker (OS comparison worker)
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=inventorysvc
Group=inventorysvc
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker
Restart=on-failure
NoNewPrivileges=true

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNIT

echo "== step 3: reload + enable + start =="
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable inventory-worker.service
sudo -n systemctl restart inventory-worker.service
sleep 2

echo "== step 4: verify =="
sudo -n systemctl is-active inventory-worker.service
sudo -n systemctl is-enabled inventory-worker.service
sudo -n systemctl status inventory-worker.service --no-pager
echo "== process owner =="
ps -eo user,pid,cmd | grep os-comparison-worker | grep -v grep
